Fresh final marker followup of meta.anchors.content.next_anchor. Preserved the previous input/output, started fresh, read the complete claim, associated implementation and test, and recaptured the prior source helper at tests/spec.rs lines 10–15. Compared all fragments by path/selector and implementation/test metadata. The sole change is an implementation_references comment on spec.rs validate_implementation_references. All claim, behavior, test, helper and metadata contents are unchanged; no fragments were removed. I assessed this unrelated marker delta against the complete prior findings and current relevant source.

The sole ordinary implementation association is the new-definition branch of parse_anchors. After validating definition syntax, paragraph position, identifier and prose, it calls finish_anchor with the new marker start, then creates a fresh active SpecAnchor with its own marker span and content start after the new name token. finish_anchor takes the previous active anchor, slices only up to that supplied boundary, trims surrounding whitespace and computes matching original source content spans. Therefore the new marker/text cannot enter the previous claim, and the new claim owns subsequent content. A first definition is allowed when no preceding active anchor exists. All helpers are within the captured implementation file.

The sole ordinary test claims_retain_all_blocks_until_the_next_definition_or_document_end creates a first marker on its own line and a second with same-line prose, without explicit ends. The first body contains Unicode prose, multiple paragraphs, a list, table, fenced and indented code and quotation. It asserts no diagnostics, exact first content equal to that body and exact second content equal to its own Unicode rule plus final qualification. For both anchors it verifies original-source content_span slices equal stored text, then explicitly asserts first.content_span.end < second.span.start. These assertions establish closure before the next marker, independent ownership and nonoverlap; the gap is boundary whitespace trimmed by finish_anchor. The captured source helper directly creates SpecSource, and the test invokes production from_sources. No TODO/N/A entries exist.

All claim aspects remain supported; the added association comment has no semantic effect. No source edits, formatting, test runs or workspace build were performed. Executed review start/read, capture comparisons and record only. No requested edits.
